Seems like a lot of money to clean a system (no new parts). We also expected that Christopher would be doing the work since we were told he operated on his own.
We were out of state while the work was being completed and it turned into the biggest nightmare. Within the first couple of days of work, they had managed to break the blower while trying to remove it to clean it (the system is less than 5 years old). They called us up with the "bad news" to let us know it would cost us a further $600-900 to replace and that the part wouldn't come in for about a week. Meanwhile, it was hot and humid and only half the house had any A/C running, while the other half of the house had a heat producing massive dehumidifier and we were supposed to move in in a few days.
Christopher and his team missed many areas of mold and his work failed the mold recheck the first 2-3 times. He claims he wasn't responsible for cleaning the mold on the outside of AC ducting, yet it was part of the HVAC remediation plan supplied by a company he supposed works with often. In the end our general remediation contractor jumped in to keep things moving. We then had to have another area rechecked, and it turned out he had missed another section of mold on the HVAC system. We arrived in the middle of the night to a home that was about 90 degrees due to the HVAC system not operating and a dehumidifier still running. A day or two later, the part arrived and Christopher got it installed. He decided not to charge us for the blower, but all in all, at this point, we were super unhappy, frustrated and felt that the whole experience was terrible! But, at least it was rectified and complete. Or so we thought.
Within a few days of the work being completed, we couldn't understand why our upstairs unit was always running and never getting below 78/80 degrees. We could feel some cool air coming through the vents, but we could not get the upstairs cool. We had guests in town so put the concern aside as we were super busy, then started looking around. We found that while working on the handler in one of the units, the tape sealing the ducting and handler was coming off and half of the cool air was blowing into the HVAC closest. It was working just fine, but only some of the air was making its way into the ducting and the rest was freezing the utility closet. We reached out to Christopher with photos and texts and asked for this to be resolved - he was the only person to have worked on the unit or to have been in the closet and we had just paid almost $7K. He responded that this was not his concern. When we asked how that could be due to the service, inspection and work completed, he continued to deny any responsibility and got defensive. When we asked what we had actually paid for, he claimed that my husband was being aggressive (by asking this question) and refused any further work!
All in all, the experience was terrible, the follow through was missing and this company does not stand by their work. If you do decide to work with this company, make sure EVERY part of the work you would like completed is noted on the proposal or they will claim it isn't in their scope.
